  > PSI-120's DB-free half, built test-first, started in parallel with the human-gated PSI-116/PSI-115 migrations (which stay with Claude Code). Added src/features/schedule/types.ts (ColumnKind + KIND_PROGRESS, the Zod estimateSchema/taskLinkInputSchema, GanttRow/NetworkRow/ScheduleTask) and three pure lib modules: view-model.ts (toPertTasks, toGanttRows, toNetworkRows, orderTasksForView, unscheduledTasks, durationInUnit/varianceInUnit/formatDuration), controls.ts (parseScheduleControls and the design's two headline strings) and link-guard.ts (linkBlockReason, predecessorCandidates). 45 new tests; the feature is 69 tests and the repo 214, all green, typecheck/lint/build clean. The Gantt rows reproduce the brief's fixture: from project_start 2026-10-01 WIB, A runs 2026-09-30T17:00Z (ES 0) to 2026-11-25T17:00Z (EF 56 d), C starts exactly on A's end, bars key on criticalPath membership, progress 100/50/0/50/0, and the headline reads "TE 35 w ± 5.9 w (k=2)" and "P(finish ≤ 38 w) = 84.6 %". Three decisions carry forward, with detail in decisions[]: an estimate is one all-or-none object matching M13's num_nonnulls check; toPertTasks DROPS unestimated tasks so a half-estimated board still renders, while a link pointing at one stays a typed missing-estimate error; and rows key criticality on criticalPath, never the node's own critical flag. Date maths uses an explicit +07:00 offset and millisecond arithmetic, never local-time parsing: tests pass identically under TZ=UTC and TZ=America/New_York, and the engine itself stays date-free. Deliberately not here: frappe-gantt is not installed and no Schedule tab is wired, because both need M13 and a DOM-only wrapper could not be verified by hand; the link and estimate writes wait for PSI-116 too. The accept is therefore not met: outcome partial, not done. Self-review found and fixed one real defect — a sub-task whose parent was in the engine's order but absent from the view's task list was silently dropped from both views.
